infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: This app needs your location to send GPS coordinates to the tracking server.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: This app needs your location to continuously send GPS coordinates to the tracking server.

plugins.locationAlwaysAndWhenInUsePermission: Allow GPS Tracker to use your location to send coordinates to the server.
plugins.locationAlwaysPermission: Allow GPS Tracker to use your location in the background.
plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: Allow GPS Tracker to use your location while using the app.
